subtitle: Eagle Creek Reservoir chlorophyll-a — frozen 22-predictor XGBoost model
caption: This is the 22-predictor model edition, separate from the original thesis viewer. Values are model predictions, not measurements. Satellite basemap is recent imagery and is not time-matched to the prediction date. Model was calibrated across many U.S. lakes; performance at any single site is sensitive to local optical conditions.
